label: Shure UABIAST (Bias-T Module With Power Supply)

_avail.note: Max input 12.4 V DC, 400 mA; bias output 12 V DC. Supplied with PS24 PSU. Datasheet URL = PDF of official user guide (no separate spec sheet linked). Price list net weight 0.45 kg differs from datasheet weight (datasheet value used).

portsSource.note: Connecting to a device p.3; specifications pp.3-4

_avail.notes: powerDrawW 3.97 W computed from the UABIAST user guide (shure/UABIAST-user-guide.pdf, DC In: 12.4 V DC, 400 mA from PS24): 12.4 × 0.4 = 4.96 VA × 0.8 (AVAIL utilisation factor), as accepted by proposal 371e537a; mostly bias power passed up the coax to UA834 / UA874. Computed: V × A × 0.8

passThroughPower.powers: 12 V DC bias over the coax to active antennas and in-line amplifiers: up to three UA834, or two UA834 and one UA874

ports.label: RF + DC
ports.notes: BNC female, 50 ohm; from the active antenna or in-line amplifier; supplies 12 V DC bias (up to three UA834, or two UA834 and one UA874); 100-2000 MHz

ports.label: RF Only
ports.notes: BNC female, 50 ohm; to the receiver antenna input; <1 dB insertion loss

ports.label: DC In
ports.notes: 12.4 V DC, 400 mA from the Shure PS24 power supply; Shure does not name the connector
